answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the sparrow queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1087 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the atlas. The trellis index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 48 pays that 154 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
